name: hot-monitor
description: 热点监控系统 - React + Express 全栈项目

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
